family: YE Edge Beam (Ireland, beam & slab construction)
description: Irish standard prestressed YE edge beams YE1-YE8 (700-1400 mm deep, 750 mm soffit width) - the edge-beam companion to the Y family, with a full-height vertical face on one side (cast-on parapet side) and an asymmetric section (published Xc = distance from the vertical face to the centroid).

sources.properties_Wf_Xc: Banagher Precast Concrete, Bridge Beam Manual, 3rd ed., printed pp. 32-33 (sources/banagher-bridge-beam-manual-3ed.pdf); identical tables in Concast brochure and in '05316 Precast Beam Properties.xls' (2007).
sources.strand_layout: Banagher manual printed p. 33: 'YE Beam Showing All Possible Strand Locations - In all beams superimposed'. Bottom rows 13@60, 14@110, 14@160, 12@210, 6@250, 1@260, 4@310, 4@350; web rows 2/4 @ 380-1330 with pair spreads 70-320 (offset toward the vertical face); a 320-wide top row pair spread at 1330.

fit.note: Topology (from the p.32 nested drawing): the LEFT face is vertical at the soffit edge for the full depth; the top runs from the left face across the published top width Wf; the right side mirrors the Y-beam lower body (soffit edge -> haunch -> waist) then runs straight to the top-right corner. Internal dims least-squares fitted to published A, yc, Xc and Ixx of all eight sizes (32 values; Wf published input). Units mm; origin at mid-soffit, y up; the vertical face is at x = -375 and published Xc is measured from that face.
